title: Frost project manifest
description: A frost.json at or above the file named on the command line. It answers what a relative import cannot: where a library this project depends on lives, and which of its directories may reach which.

name.description: What the project calls itself. Not used for resolution. It is here so a diagnostic can name the project rather than a directory.

paths.description: Directories to search for an import, relative to this manifest. Searched after the importing file's own directory and any -L path.

items.description: A directory, relative to this manifest

layers.description: The project's layers, lowest first, relative to this manifest. A file under one may import from its own layer or from any listed before it, and reaching a later one is refused when the import is resolved. A file under none of them is unconstrained.

items.description: A directory, relative to this manifest
